This trial in phases II and III is investigating the efficacy of rituximab in treating Rheumatoid Arthritis patients who are inadequate responders to methotrexate or TNF-alpha antagonists, with eligibility criteria including specific IgG and IgM levels, stable prednisone dose, and exclusion criteria such as active infections, malignancies, and psychiatric disorders, with icd-10 code A0104.

This trial in Phase 2 is testing the infusion of Myocet for patients with cerebral lymphoma B cell refractory or relapsed within 12 months after first-line chemotherapy, with specific eligibility criteria including age, performance index, hematologic, hepatic, renal, and cardiac function, as well as exclusion criteria such as immunosuppression and prior anthracycline treatment.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the efficacy of simeprevir and daclatasvir in treating chronic Hepatitis C genotype 1b infection, with specific eligibility criteria including liver fibrosis staging, BMI requirement, and treatment-naive status, while excluding participants with certain genetic variants, liver complications, or co-infections with other hepatitis viruses.

Phase II trial testing the drug MK2578 in patients with anemia and chronic kidney disease, with eligibility criteria including being on hemodialysis for at least 6 months, having received epoetin alfa or epoetin beta for at least 6 months, and exclusion criteria such as having a life expectancy of less than 6 months, history of blood dyscrasia, and certain icd-10 codes.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of thalidomide for chronic pancreatitis patients with specific pain criteria, excluding those with certain conditions like diabetes, alcohol abuse, and hypercoagulable states, and requiring participants to meet various eligibility criteria including VAS scale scoring and compliance with the FDA-mandated S.T.E.P.S.® program.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of lonafarnib, peginterferon alfa-2a, and ritonavir in treating Chronic Hepatitis D Infection, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria including the requirement for a positive anti-HDV Ab test, detectable HDV RNA, and various health conditions and drug restrictions.

This study in Phase 2 is focused on evaluating the drug spm 927 for the treatment of Postherpetic Neuralgia, with the eligibility criteria specifying the inclusion of patients with this condition and the exclusion of those who do not benefit from long-term treatment, as indicated by the icd-10 code B0223.

This study in Phase 2 is investigating the use of sch-d (vicriviroc) in HIV-infected individuals experiencing virologic failure on current ART regimens, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria outlined for each step of the study, including the requirement for participants to have R5-only HIV strain and the exclusion of certain medications and conditions.

This study in Phase 2 is investigating the use of etravirine (Intelence) and truvada in individuals with HIV Infections, with specific eligibility criteria including documented HIV-1 infection, certain laboratory values, and restrictions on reproductive activities, while excluding individuals with prior exposure to certain antiretroviral drugs and specific mutations, among other exclusion criteria.

This study in PHASE2 is investigating the efficacy of amprenavir, abt-378/r, and ritonavir in HIV-infected individuals with specific criteria including CD4 cell count below 300/mm3 and previous treatment with certain protease inhibitors and non-nucleoside analogues, while excluding individuals with pregnancy, alcohol abuse, and history of pancreatitis or hepatic failure.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the drug ski-606 (bosutinib) for patients with Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia who are resistant or intolerant to imatinib, with specific eligibility criteria including prior imatinib therapy, performance status, and age range, while excluding patients with certain conditions like Philadelphia chromosome negative CML and cardiac diseases, and requiring reliable birth control methods during the study.

This study is evaluating the use of entecavir in individuals with co-infection of HIV and HBV, requiring specific criteria such as stable antiretroviral therapy, documented HBV viremia, and absence of other liver diseases, with the icd-10 code B0081.

This phase II trial is investigating the use of peginesatide in patients with chronic kidney disease on hemodialysis, with specific eligibility criteria including stable hemoglobin levels, adequate iron and vitamin levels, and exclusion criteria such as intolerance to erythropoiesis stimulating agents and certain medical conditions.

This phase II trial for Rheumatoid Arthritis patients with active disease despite MTX therapy will test the efficacy of drugs f8il10 and mtx, with eligibility criteria including previous inadequate response to anti-TNF drugs, stable corticosteroid regimen, and specific hematologic, liver, and renal function requirements.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the drug enzastaurin for patients with Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma, with specific eligibility criteria including histologically confirmed mycosis fungoides or Sezary Syndrome, stage IB to IVB disease, and adequate organ function, while excluding those receiving concurrent treatment for CTCL or with serious cardiac conditions, and the trial is associated with the ICD-10 code A067.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the efficacy of multiple drugs including sovaprevir, pegylated interferon alpha-2a, and ribavirin in treating chronic hepatitis C genotype 1, with specific eligibility criteria for participants such as age, treatment history, and contraceptive use, and exclusion criteria related to BMI, pregnancy, liver disease, substance use, and various medical conditions, with the icd-10 code 'B0081' associated with the study.

This trial in PHASE2 is investigating the efficacy of various antiretroviral drugs, including mk0518 monotherapy and combination therapy, efavirenz, tenofovir, and lamivudine monotherapy, in HIV-positive patients who have received less than 7 days of antiretroviral therapy, with inclusion and exclusion criteria specified, and icd-10 codes A028 and D849 related to HIV infections.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of gsk573719 and tiotropium in Caucasian subjects with COPD, focusing on eligibility criteria related to smoking history, lung function, and exclusion criteria such as drug screening results and comorbidities like prostatic hypertrophy and cardiovascular conditions.

This study in Phase 2 focuses on the use of chlorhexidine gluconate oral rinse (0.12%) for intubated and mechanically ventilated trauma ICU patients with pneumonia, excluding those with specific conditions like hypersensitivity to CHX, thrombocytopenia, and immunosuppression, and including comatose patients at high risk for respiratory infection.

This trial in PHASE1 and PHASE2 is investigating the use of carvedilol in patients with Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria including NYHA class II or III, optimized PAH treatment for at least 3 months, and various cardiovascular and health parameters, with the icd-10 code A212.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the drug alt-711 in patients with Chronic Heart Failure, focusing on those with NYHA II-IV heart failure and echocardiographic ejection fraction ≤ 45%, while excluding patients with certain medical conditions such as uncontrolled diabetes mellitus and severe anemia.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of lumiracoxib and diclofenac in managing chronic joint pain in patients with pre-existing chronic kidney injury stage K/DOQI III, who are stable and without contraindications for NSAID therapy, while excluding those with recent NSAID use, PUD, ESRD, hypersensitivity to treatments, GI bleeding, impaired liver function, or ACEI/ARB use.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of aspirin and clopidogrel in HIV patients with specific eligibility criteria, excluding those with low CD4+ T cell counts, cardiovascular disease, NSAID use, and other conditions, with icd-10 codes A5054 and H019.

This trial in phase II is investigating the use of lonafarnib and ritonavir in patients with Hepatitis D, who meet specific eligibility criteria including elevated liver enzymes, presence of anti-HDV and quantifiable HDV RNA, while excluding those with decompensated liver disease, pregnancy, significant systemic illnesses, substance abuse, and other specific conditions, with the icd-10 code B0081.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the efficacy of alisporivir, peginterferon alfa-2a, and ribavirin in treating chronic hepatitis C viral infection with specific eligibility criteria including HCV genotype 2 or 3 and exclusion criteria such as evidence of cirrhosis or hepatocellular carcinoma; icd-10 codes associated with the trial are B0081 and A393.

Phase II trial for Postherpetic Neuralgia testing t-62 doses 1 and 2 with eligibility criteria including diagnosis confirmation, general good health, and exclusion criteria such as specific medical disorders and medication restrictions.

This study in phase II is investigating the use of acipimox in individuals with abdominal obesity, insulin resistance, and hypertriglyceridemia, with specific eligibility criteria related to BMI, waist circumference, triglyceride levels, and insulin resistance markers, while excluding individuals with certain medical conditions and medication use.

This phase II trial aims to evaluate the efficacy of sufentanil and sustained release morphine sulfate in managing moderate to severe chronic cancer pain in patients aged 18 to 75 with a diagnosis of cancer, while excluding individuals with various medical conditions and substance abuse history.

This Phase 2 trial for Rheumatoid Arthritis is investigating the drug peficitinib, with eligibility criteria including completion of a previous study with ASP015K, and exclusion criteria such as out of range laboratory values and specific icd-10 codes A0104 and M0510.

Phase II trial for untreated Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia patients, testing the efficacy of cyclophosphamide, fludarabine, sargramostim, and rituximab, with eligibility criteria including specific disease indications, prior immunotherapy limits, and various organ function requirements, while excluding patients with active hepatitis B, concurrent chemotherapy, pregnancy, HIV history, and symptomatic CNS disease.

This trial is investigating the drug "bdp/formoterol next dpi" in patients with Pulmonary Disease, Chronic Obstructive, and Asthma, with specific eligibility criteria for each condition, and icd-10 codes A212 and A393.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of cyclophosphamide in patients with various hematologic malignancies such as leukemia, myeloma, myelodysplastic syndromes, and myeloproliferative disorders, with specific eligibility criteria including disease characteristics and patient characteristics, and requiring a phenotypic match for donors.

This study in Phase 2 focuses on patients with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) and evaluates the efficacy of various drugs including ep-101 and tiotropium bromide, with specific eligibility criteria and exclusion criteria, such as age range, smoking history, lung function parameters, and medical history, with the icd-10 code A393.

This phase II trial is investigating the drug sta-2 for patients with Chronic Stable Angina, with eligibility criteria including positive ETT results and exclusion criteria such as heart failure and hepatic failure, with the icd-10 code A393.

This study in Phase 2 is focused on evaluating the drug "agn 203818" for the treatment of painful bladder syndrome/interstitial cystitis, with specific eligibility criteria related to bladder pain and exclusion criteria including uncontrolled diseases and pregnancy, targeting icd-10 codes A0681 and J982.

This study in phases 1 and 2 is investigating the use of OMS201 and a vehicle in patients undergoing retrograde ureteroscopic removal of urinary stones, with eligibility criteria including age range, anesthesia requirement, and exclusion criteria related to allergies, medical history, and laboratory evaluations.

This phase II trial for chronic Hepatitis C will evaluate the efficacy of a combination therapy including ppi-668, bi 207127, faldaprevir, and ribavirin in treatment-naïve patients meeting specific eligibility criteria, while excluding those with certain medical conditions such as HIV, Hepatitis B, decompensated liver disease, and cardiovascular or pulmonary diseases.

Phase II trial for patients with Hemophilia, HIV Infections, and Hepatitis C, testing the efficacy of peginterferon alfa-2a and ribavirin in treating chronic hepatitis with specific eligibility and exclusion criteria, including requirements for HCV and HIV status, liver biopsy confirmation, and restrictions on previous therapies and comorbidities.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of glutamine and glycine in reducing the frequency of herpes labialis outbreaks in adults with a history of frequent episodes, with strict inclusion and exclusion criteria including restrictions on antiviral medications and specific health conditions, and the icd-10 code B0082 associated with the conditions 'Herpes Labialis' and 'Herpes Simplex Virus'.

This study in phase 2 is investigating the use of etanercept for patients with Rheumatoid Arthritis, with specific eligibility criteria including disease activity measures, medication restrictions, and contraceptive requirements.

This trial in phase II is investigating the use of cyclophosphamide, fludarabine phosphate, tacrolimus, and mycophenolate mofetil in patients with various hematopoietic/lymphoid cancers, including chronic myeloid leukemia, acute myeloid leukemia, high-risk acute lymphoblastic leukemia, myelodysplastic syndromes, multiple myeloma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, and Hodgkin's Disease, who may benefit from tandem autologous-nonmyeloablative allogeneic transplant.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of Stribild and Atripla in HIV patients with specific eligibility criteria, such as plasma HIV-1 RNA levels, CD4 cell count, and various exclusion criteria including drug resistance, hepatitis status, and cardiac conditions.

Phase II trial testing tafenoquine for malaria in healthy subjects aged 18-55 residing in Nyanza Province, with exclusion criteria including cardiovascular, liver, neurologic, or renal abnormalities, pregnancy, antimalarial drug use, hypersensitivity to study drugs, and G6PD deficiency (icd_code: B54).

This trial in Phase 2 focuses on patients with cryptococcal meningitis, testing drugs like itraconazole, flucytosine, fluconazole, amphotericin b, and interferon gamma-1b, with specific eligibility and exclusion criteria outlined, including age requirements, medication restrictions, and various health conditions.

This study in Phase 2 is evaluating the efficacy of pegylated interferon alfa-2a and nucleos(t)ide analogues in adult participants with chronic hepatitis B, excluding those with certain co-infections, liver diseases, psychiatric conditions, and other specific medical histories, while also requiring negative pregnancy tests for women of childbearing potential and the use of reliable contraception during the study.

This study in Phase 2 is investigating the efficacy of bifonazole spray and lamisil for treating athlete's foot (Tinea Pedis) in adults aged 18-70 with specific severity criteria, excluding those with certain allergies or previous antifungal treatments, and the ICD-10 code associated is B353.

This trial in Phase 2 focuses on patients with Rheumatoid Arthritis, testing the efficacy of methotrexate, rituximab, and corticosteroids in those who have failed previous treatments, with eligibility criteria including age range, duration of diagnosis, and specific treatment history.

This phase II trial focuses on patients with Stage IV Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma, testing the combination of cisplatin, 5-FU, and nimotuzumab, with specific eligibility criteria including age range, performance status, and laboratory values, while excluding those with CNS metastases, previous investigational therapy, or certain medical conditions.

This study in phases 2 and 3 is investigating the use of albendazole for conditions such as helminthiasis, tinea capitis, and anemia, with eligibility criteria including consenting parents and guardians, and exclusion criteria for children with known allergy to papaya fruit products, along with icd-10 codes B839 and L210.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of filgotinib for rheumatoid arthritis patients who completed specific core studies, with key inclusion criteria related to long-term treatment benefit and birth control, and key exclusion criteria including abnormal lab values and other autoimmune diseases.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of albuferon and ribavirin in patients with chronic Hepatitis C who have previously failed interferon alfa treatment, with specific eligibility criteria related to liver function and exclusion criteria such as decompensated cirrhosis or pregnancy, and an icd-10 code of B0081 for current drug or alcohol addiction.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of ldv/sof in chronic genotype 1 or 4 infected patients with sickle cell disease, with specific eligibility criteria including HCV RNA levels, cirrhosis determination, and screening laboratory values, while excluding pregnant or nursing females, co-infection with HIV or HBV, and history of hepatic decompensation or malignancy.

This clinical trial is testing the efficacy of rad001 and imatinib in treating Chronic Myeloid Leukemia patients who meet specific disease, organ function, and cardiac function criteria, while excluding those with certain prior treatments, hypersensitivity, psychiatric disorders, noncompliance history, or other severe concurrent diseases.

This trial in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the use of bupivacaine collagen sponge for postoperative pain management in patients undergoing inguinal herniorrhaphy, with specific eligibility and exclusion criteria including BMI range, surgical requirements, medication restrictions, and various medical conditions, while targeting icd-10 code A58.

This trial in Phase 2 focuses on patients with various hematologic conditions such as Chronic Myelomonocytic Leukemia and Polycythemia Vera, testing the drugs cyclosporine, fludarabine phosphate, and mycophenolate mofetil, with eligibility criteria including age restrictions and specific disease characteristics.

This study in phases II and III focuses on testing different artemether-lumefantrine combinations with primaquine for treating malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum in children aged 2 to 15 years, with specific eligibility criteria and exclusion criteria, including normal G6PD enzyme function and icd-10 codes B54, A522, and B500.

This phase II trial is investigating the efficacy of lamivudine and adefovir in patients with chronic hepatitis B, who meet specific eligibility criteria including detectable HBV-DNA levels, liver biopsy consistent with chronic hepatitis, and exclusion criteria such as previous treatment with adefovir or tenofovir, co-infection with HDV, HCV, or HIV, and other liver diseases.

This trial in phases 2 and 3 is investigating the efficacy of antimalarial drugs including sp, amodiaquine, piperaquine, dihydroartemisinin, intermittent preventive treatment, and du-cotecxin in children aged 1 to 5 years with malaria, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria, and the icd-10 code B54 related to the study.

This study in PHASE1 and PHASE2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of the drug kbsa301 in treating severe pneumonia caused by Staphylococcus aureus in ICU patients, with specific eligibility criteria including age range, APACHE II score, and exclusion criteria such as hypersensitivity to medications and various medical conditions, with the icd-10 code A0103 associated with the study.

This clinical trial in phases 1 and 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of the topically applied cream BC-DN-01 for diabetic neuropathy and pain relief in patients with Type I or II diabetes mellitus, meeting specific eligibility criteria including HbA1c levels, ability to comply with study protocol, and exclusion criteria such as severe neuropathy and certain medical conditions, with icd-10 codes B0223 and N5312.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of pioglitazone in patients with NASH, focusing on eligibility criteria such as liver biopsy findings consistent with NASH, ALT levels, and exclusion criteria including history of hepatotoxicity to PPARg agonists and seropositivity for HBsAg, anti-HCV, or anti-HIV.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the efficacy of bi 207127 na, peginterferon, and ribavirin in treating chronic hepatitis C genotype 1, with specific eligibility criteria including therapy-naïve patients with plasma HCV RNA = 100,000 IU/mL at screening and exclusion criteria such as HIV co-infection and decompensated liver disease.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of iodinated active charcoal (iodocarb) in patients with Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease (COPD) meeting specific inclusion criteria, such as age range, smoking history, and COPD severity, while excluding individuals with certain conditions like Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency and iodine allergy, and with specific medical history like recent exacerbations or use of oral steroids.

This trial in phase II is investigating the drug SCH66336 for patients with Philadelphia chromosome-positive CML who have failed imatinib mesylate, with eligibility criteria including age \>/= 16 years, adequate organ functions, and exclusion of certain medications, with ICD-10 codes A393.

This trial in PHASE1 and PHASE2 is investigating lenalidomide and fludarabine for the treatment of Chronic Lymphocytic B-Cell Leukemia, with specific eligibility criteria including B-CLL markers, NCI treatment indication, age requirement, and exclusion criteria such as infections and organ dysfunctions.

This phase II trial is investigating the efficacy of cyclophosphamide, fludarabine phosphate, and lenalidomide in treating patients with symptomatic and active intermediate or high-risk chronic lymphocytic leukemia, with specific eligibility criteria including B-cell CLL diagnosis, modified Rai staging system, performance status, and pregnancy precautions.

This trial in phase II is investigating lenalidomide for the treatment of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukaemia, with specific eligibility criteria including confirmed diagnosis of B-cell CLL, no prior systemic therapy, symptomatic disease, and specific laboratory requirements, while excluding patients with certain medical conditions and prior use of lenalidomide.

This trial in PHASE2 and PHASE3 is testing the drug amn107 for Imatinib-resistant or -intolerant Philadelphia chromosome-positive CML, with eligibility criteria including age ≥ 18 and exclusion criteria such as impaired cardiac function and CNS infiltration, with icd-10 code A393.

This trial in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of nox-h94 solution in treating clinically significant anemia of chronic disease attributed to malignancy, with specific eligibility criteria including hemoglobin levels, transferrin saturation, and iron levels, while excluding patients with certain medical conditions and history of specific treatments; icd_code: ['A393'].

This trial in Phase 2 focuses on the treatment of Pulmonary Tuberculosis using the drugs tmc207 and rifafour e-275 mg, with specific eligibility criteria including sputum smear positivity and exclusion criteria such as hypersensitivity to study medications and certain medical conditions, with the icd-10 code A212.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of enfuvirtide and tenofovir-emtricitabine in patients with HIV infections and Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML), with specific eligibility criteria including confirmed HIV diagnosis, active PML for less than 90 days, and detection of JCV DNA in the CSF, while excluding those with certain opportunistic infections and prior specific treatments, and the associated ICD-10 codes are A812, M355, and A028.

This study in Phase 2 focuses on patients with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) who are being treated with roflumilast, assessing their eligibility based on criteria such as age, BMI, smoking history, and specific medication use, while excluding patients with certain conditions like heart failure, cancer, and immunological diseases.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of drug bgg492a in treating chronic subjective tinnitus in patients with THI severity grade 3, 4, or 5, who are willing to abstain from activities requiring focused attention and loud noise exposure, while excluding patients with certain types of tinnitus, hearing loss, psychiatric disorders, and other specified conditions.

This trial in phase II is investigating the use of bosutinib and bone marrow cells in patients with Chronic Myeloid Leukaemia who have failed to achieve a Major Cytogenetic Response after TKIs treatment, and are eligible for hematopoietic cell transplantation with specific donor criteria, while excluding patients with certain comorbidities and infections.

This trial in PHASE1 and PHASE2 is investigating the drug idx719 for participants with chronic Hepatitis C, who must have documented GT1, GT2, or GT3 infection, and meet specific eligibility criteria including good general health and use of double-barrier birth control method post-treatment, while excluding pregnant or breastfeeding individuals, those with prior HCV treatment, and those co-infected with HBV and/or HIV, with icd-10 codes B0081 and A393.

This trial in phases 2 and 3 is investigating the use of nefopam and its comparator in patients aged 55-75 undergoing cardiac surgery for specific conditions like hyperalgesia and chronic pain, with eligibility criteria including ASA score of 1-3 and exclusion criteria such as drug or alcohol abuse history and allergy to nefopam.

This study in phases PHASE1 and PHASE2 is investigating the drug amd11070 for HIV Infections, with eligibility criteria including HIV-1 infection, specific viral load requirements, and restrictions on medication use, while excluding individuals with certain medical conditions and drug dependencies, and pregnant or breastfeeding individuals (icd_code: A028).

This trial in PHASE1 and PHASE2 is investigating the use of etanercept and rituximab in patients with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia and Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma, who must meet specific eligibility criteria including prior treatment for CLL/SLL, CD20 expression, and absence of certain medical conditions, with icd-10 codes A393 and A872.

This trial in phase II is investigating the efficacy of cts-1027, pegylated interferon, and ribavirin in treating null responders with HCV genotype 1 infection, who meet specific eligibility criteria including HCV-RNA viral load, hemoglobin levels, and previous treatment adherence, while excluding patients with severe liver disease, psychiatric disorders, or other specified conditions.

This study is investigating the efficacy of drug SM04554 in treating Androgenetic Alopecia, with inclusion criteria including clinical diagnosis of AGA, willingness to receive a scalp tattoo, and exclusion criteria such as previous exposure to SM04554 and use of certain hair growth products, with the ICD-10 code A5132 associated with the condition.

This study in Phase 2 focuses on Chronic Idiopathic Urticaria and evaluates the efficacy of omalizumab, h1 antihistamines, and diphenhydramine in patients meeting specific inclusion and exclusion criteria, including restrictions on previous omalizumab treatment and certain medications, with the icd-10 code A393.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of various bimatoprost formulations and minoxidil 5% solution in treating mild to moderate male pattern baldness (androgenic alopecia), with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria, including the requirement for a micro-dot-tattoo on the scalp and restrictions on certain treatments and substances.

This study in Phase 2 focuses on patients with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) aged over 40, evaluating the efficacy of glycopyrrolate compared to a comparator, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria and associated ICD-10 codes A212 and A393.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of nevirapine, lamivudine, and zidovudine in HIV-infected pediatric patients who are antiretroviral drug naive, with specific eligibility criteria including age range, HIV-1 infection evidence, viral load, CD4 count, and exclusion criteria such as significant diseases other than HIV and pregnancy.

This study in Phase 2 is evaluating the efficacy of ibalizumab in patients with HIV Infections who have shown a significant decline in HIV-1 RNA levels and meet specific inclusion criteria, while excluding those with active AIDS-defining illnesses or significant diseases, and requiring participants to be willing to use contraception if sexually active.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of unfractionated heparin and dalteparin in patients with Septic Shock who meet specific eligibility criteria, excluding those with certain conditions like cardiogenic shock or a history of adverse reactions to UFH, and with an icd-10 code of R6520.

Phase II trial for Atopic Dermatitis testing various doses of jnj-26113100 in adult participants with inclusion criteria including skin rash involving ≥10% body surface area, negative pregnancy test for females, good general health, and contraception requirements, while excluding participants with certain health abnormalities, elevated liver enzymes, interfering skin conditions, recent use of investigational drugs or biologics, with icd-10 code B653.

This study in phases 2 and 3 focuses on the treatment of Chronic Periodontitis using various drug combinations including srp plus gel, srp plus alendronate gel, and srp plus metformin gel, with specific eligibility criteria and exclusion criteria, targeting patients with specific periodontal conditions and excluding those with certain systemic diseases and medication history.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of omalizumab (Xolair) in patients with smoking-related COPD, focusing on specific eligibility criteria such as post-bronchodilator FEV1, BODE score, and exclusion criteria including history of omalizumab use and various pulmonary diseases.

This study in Phase 2 is investigating the drug azd1722 in individuals with Chronic Kidney Disease and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, with specific eligibility criteria related to age, BMI, diabetes medication use, CKD stage, blood pressure levels, and urinary albumin levels, while excluding individuals with certain medical history and conditions.

Phase II trial for relapsed or refractory acute lymphocytic leukemia and lymphoblastic lymphoma, testing methotrexate, vincristine, peg-l-asparaginase, dexamethasone, and rituximab, with eligibility criteria including age \>/= 1 year, adequate liver and renal function, and exclusion criteria of pregnant patients.

This trial in phase II is investigating the use of dasatinib in patients with refractory Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia, focusing on eligibility criteria such as prior treatment failure, age criteria, disease progression indicators, and specific medical requirements, while excluding patients with certain medical conditions and medication interactions.

This study in phases PHASE1 and PHASE2 aims to evaluate the effectiveness of oral amoxicillin in treating non-severe pneumonia in children aged 2-59 months, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria, and the condition is identified by the ICD-10 code A0103.

This trial in PHASE2 is investigating the vasopressin V2 receptor antagonist in patients with Chronic Heart Failure who must meet specific eligibility criteria including NYHA Class IIIB and IV, age 21 to 80 years, and receiving a diuretic and an ACE inhibitor (or an angiotensin II receptor antagonist), with the icd-10 code A393.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the efficacy of nilotinib in male and female patients with Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia (CML) who have confirmed molecular relapse after imatinib discontinuation, with specific eligibility criteria including age, liver and kidney function, ECOG score, and exclusion criteria such as pregnancy, other malignancies, and cardiovascular or psychiatric diseases.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the drug "fuzheng huayu" for chronic hepatitis C infection in subjects who failed previous Interferon therapy, with main inclusion criteria including documented HCV infection and exclusion criteria such as decompensated liver disease and recent HCV treatment.

This study in Phase 2 is investigating the use of tenofovir disoproxil fumarate for HIV prevention in HIV-seronegative individuals aged 18-35 who are sexually active and have had multiple sexual partners, with specific eligibility criteria related to renal and liver function, serum phosphorus levels, and overall good health, indicated by the ICD-10 code A028.

This study in phase II is investigating the use of rituxan, melphalan, thiotepa, fludarabine, cyclophosphamide, and mesna in patients with hematologic malignancies such as Acute Myelogenous Leukemia (AML), Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL), Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia (CML), Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma (NHL), and others, with specific eligibility criteria including age restrictions and organ function requirements.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of azithromycin in treating ventilator-associated pneumonia caused by Pseudomonas infections in ICU patients, with specific eligibility criteria including Apache score range, tracheal aspirate results, and exclusion criteria such as macrolide therapy, BMI limits, and specific medical conditions, with relevant ICD-10 codes provided.

This phase II trial for Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) is investigating the efficacy of pamrevlumab, pirfenidone, and nintedanib in participants meeting specific eligibility criteria, including age, IPF diagnosis criteria, lung function, and medication history, while excluding those with certain conditions such as pregnancy, other lung diseases, recent infections, or cancer history.

This study in Phase 2 is investigating the use of tenofovir disoproxil fumarate and tenofovir gel for HIV prevention in HIV-uninfected individuals with specific eligibility criteria and exclusion criteria, including normal Pap smear results, effective contraception use, and exclusion of adverse reactions to study products and latex, among others.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of Xeomin and Botox for children aged 2-12 with spastic paraplegia or hemiparesis in pediatric cerebral palsy, equine and equinovarus foot posture, with specific eligibility and exclusion criteria, and icd-10 codes B4281 and G8220.

This phase II trial is investigating the efficacy of high dose methylprednisolone, ofatumumab, and lenalidomide in patients with relapsed or refractory Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia or Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma, with specific eligibility criteria including CD5+/CD20+ B-Cell confirmation and various laboratory test result requirements, while excluding patients with certain medical conditions and infections.

This study in Phase 2 focuses on evaluating the efficacy of the drugs 'matching' and 'btl-tml-hsv' in treating Oral Herpes Simplex, with specific eligibility criteria related to cold sore history and UV exposure, and the ICD-10 code B0082 associated with the condition.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of econazole nitrate cream and foam in treating Tinea Pedis (Athlete's Foot) in adults, with inclusion criteria focusing on clinical diagnosis, fungal evidence, and general health status, while excluding individuals with certain medical conditions and recent medication use.

Phase II trial for pulmonary hypertension using qutenza (8% capsaicin) in patients with documented debilitating pain and subcutaneous treprostinil, excluding those with uncontrolled hypertension or recent stroke or myocardial infarction.

This trial is testing the efficacy of imatinib mesylate tablets in treating Philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML) patients in chronic phase or Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST) who are currently on a regimen of 400 mg imatinib mesylate tablets, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria, and icd-10 codes A393 and A213.

This trial in PHASE1 and PHASE2 is investigating the use of ftc/tdf, a drug combination, for HIV prevention in individuals at risk for HIV infection, with specific eligibility and exclusion criteria including STI screening, pregnancy testing, and exclusion of confirmed HIV or chronic hepatitis B infection.

This study aims to evaluate the efficacy of levobupivacaine in managing intractable abdominal pain secondary to inoperable pancreatic cancer in patients who meet specific eligibility criteria, including being ≥ 18 years old with confirmed pancreatic cancer and a VAS score ≥ 4, while excluding those with contraindications such as coagulopathy, previous neurolytic blocks, or expected survival less than 6 weeks.

Phase II trial for COPD treatment with drug td-4208, targeting moderate-to-severe stable COPD patients with specific spirometry criteria and smoking history, excluding those with significant respiratory diseases or hypersensitivity to inhaled agents, and requiring long-term oxygen therapy.
